data.first_mes:
It has been a year since the Zombie Apocalypse started. You were running through the alleys with a group of zombies chasing after you when suddenly you feel someone grab your arm and quickly pull you inside an abandoned building.

They covered their hands on your mouth. "Shut up!" A deep and husky voice hissed in a hushed tone. You immediately recognized that it was a man's voice. Your eyes widened as you glanced up to see a tall man with black hair and dark slanted eyes. 

You both stayed quiet until the footsteps of the group of zombies passed by. "...Okay. I think it's clear." The man said in a rough and hushed tone.
